bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 5, 6. BRING ME CHOCOLATE scored with authority on debut at Muswellbrook before she immediately took the next step last start at Wyong. She is now more than ready to make a home track debut. SEQUINNED overcame an unsuitable tempo to score first up on the Kensington track after gear changes had been made. She can only now present race-fitter. BLESSED EAGLE led throughout here on debut with Tim Clark aboard two weeks ago and he should already have more to offer today with Tim retaining the ride. KATOTO begins her second campaign today. This journey should be ideal first up after trialing twice in August. SAFFRON VEIL was a dual acceptor for this meeting and after handing in a most pleasing debut effort here last start, she must be treated with respect in whichever race she contests today.

raceTips.comment: Bring Me Chocolate has shown enough ability in recent outings and looks suited by the way this race is likely to be run, with the speed underneath helping her settle into a handy position. Sequinned has been racing consistently and should appreciate getting conditions to suit, with a strong turn of foot making her dangerous when produced at the right time. Saffron Veil has displayed good tactical speed and can put herself into the race early, giving her every chance to fight out the finish. Blessed Eagle is another who looks capable of running well off the current mark, with the gelding likely to settle close enough to the speed and conserve energy for the final stages.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 5, 9, 11 and 18. WAIHEKE ROSE has trialed twice since a spell with Tim Clark aboard on both occasions. Unlike some, she can be expected to cope over this testing distance when she now makes her race-day debut. SING YOUR SONG became unsuited in transit first up at Canterbury when she refused to shirk her task in defeat in a race that's produced sting form. She's race-fitter now. SAFFRON VEIL did all but win here on debut last start and natural improvement can now be expected. SATIN SERENADE was beaten at very short odds here last start when she was produced after two trials and a seventy-two day break. She can atone in the same class today without causing a surprise.

raceTips.comment: Sing Your Song was strong through the line over 1200m when resuming last start, the filly would have taken considerable improvement off that performance and will appreciate the step up to 1400m. The Waterhouse & Bott trained Waiheke Rose has trailled strongly leading in and from the inside draw will make her own luck handy to the speed throughout with the in form jockey on board.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 8. APPEARED was resuming when he made his Australian debut last start at Newcastle. He handed in quick closing sectionals to score over 1880m and he can already be expected to be suited by a distance rise that now awaits. FORBIDDEN RIFF must not be harshly judged for an unplaced latest Randwick effort when there were excuses. A drop in class aids his cause today. SUNBURNT COUNTRY looked the part on the Acton track at his Canberra home base last start and he has performed pleasingly elsewhere before. PROXIMA CENTAURI was honest five days ago at Gosford and she will have scope to improve when a quick back-up can be regarded as a plus, making her home track debut.

raceTips.comment: Appeared looks well placed to make his presence felt after showing a solid level of ability in his recent preparation, with the gelding capable of settling close to the speed. Forbidden Riff has been building a handy record and possesses enough tactical speed to secure a favourable position, which should give him every chance to be competitive late. Sunburnt Country has plenty of upside and looks suited getting into a race where he can travel comfortably before being asked for an effort in the straight.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 6, 7. SAVOONGA was partnered for the first time with Zac Lloyd when she was dominant third up over this distance last start at Wyong and she's now more than ready to make a Warwick Farm debut with Zac retaining the ride. LEICA STORM presents third up in his first preparation since a stable change. He has recently done enough at Kembla Grange and then at Newcastle to be treated with respect when he now presents at his new home base. THINK ITZ YOU conceded too great a start first up here last start in a race won by a subsequent Rosehill winner (Mr Miller) last Saturday. He can be expected to appreciate the distance rise that awaits here second up.  NATURAL RULER handed in a career best effort when he tackled this journey last start at Kembla Grange. He was produced after a thirty-one day break on the day and a quicker back-up can now be regarded as a plus. MAZIS started at double-figure odds when he performed above market place expectations here at home first up. Gear changes had been made on the day when Braith Nock was aboard for the first time. He's more suitably placed today with Braith retaining the ride.

raceTips.comment: Flying From Above has been racing in good fashion and looks capable of holding a prominent position from the outset, which should allow the mare to dictate her own race. Savoonga brings a consistent profile and has the tactical speed to settle within striking distance, with the ability to sustain a strong run when produced at the right time. Leica Storm has been competitive against solid opposition and looks suited by a race where the gelding can settle just behind the leading runners. Think Itz You has enough ability to make his presence felt and should be able to travel comfortably before looking for a gap in the straight.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 4, 6, 7, 12, 14. QUEEN'S GAMBLE was making her home track debut when she stylishly opened her account here last start. Stepping up from 1300m will not cause her any problems today. ASILAH was beaten at short odds when she was resuming last start at Newcastle but solid form has already emerged from her race and she can atone here when she now presents race-fitter. KAKADU SUNSET was resuming at Canterbury when her effort was game in a race that's produced strong form. She was competing with a gear change made (blinkers on) and this race will be within her reach when she presents in the same class second up. THRILL HUNTER will be making her Warwick Farm debut when she appreciates a switch away from Saturday competition second up at Rosehill. OAKFIELD NEPTUNE finished unplaced as favourite at Canterbury. There were however excuses and she will now have scope to improve when she competes in blinkers for the first time.

raceTips.comment: Asilah has shown good ability in her recent outings and looks suited by the expected tempo, with the mare capable of settling handy and conserving energy for the final stages. Queen's Gamble has been holding her form well and possesses the acceleration to put herself into contention quickly when the pace increases. Kakadu Sunset looks an interesting runner with plenty of scope for improvement, and the filly should benefit from getting a favourable position in the run. Thrill Hunter has been competitive without having everything go his way and can be dangerous if he gets the right cover, with a sustained finishing burst likely to keep him in contention.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 6, 10, 11, 13. GUS THE GREAT returns to his home base and he will be attempting to notch a hat-trick after leading throughout at Gosford and then at Hawkesbury. A slight distance rise should pose no problems for him here. ANTHROPOID was dominant when he stepped up into this distance range last start at Wyong and he should have more to offer when he presents third up. CAVALRY trialed late last month at his Rosehill home base. There were excuses for a first up Bendigo defeat when he began his last preparation and he can make hos presence felt when he now makes a Warwick Farm debut first up today. OAKFIELD ALASKA was spelled after he remained unbeaten throughout his three start first campaign. After trialing twice in August, he begins another preparation today when he will be ready to make his Warwick Farm debut.

raceTips.comment: Gus The Great has continued to show promise and looks suited by the likely shape of this contest, with the gelding possessing enough speed to settle in a prominent position. Waerea has been racing consistently and should appreciate having runners around him, allowing the gelding to travel comfortably before building momentum through the straight. Anthropoid has the ability to put himself into the race early and can make his own luck near the speed, which gives him an important advantage. Sociable has shown enough in recent performances to warrant respect and should be capable of finishing strongly if he gets the right passage, particularly with a genuine tempo.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 12, 14, 15, 16. MANUKAU was resuming when her unplaced effort here over this distance last start was better than it appears at face value. She can only now present race-fitter. ACTON KING was dominant at his Canberra home base on the Acton track last start and he is proven away from home. VELLA'S BEST displayed determination to score on the Kensington track with Nash Rawiller aboard last start and a history can repeat with Nash retaining the ride here. SHE'S EXTRA was outclassed first up at Rosehill and that will not be the case when she presents here second up. She was dominant at her only previous outing on this track. FUADEE had trialed twice at his Randwick home base before he found the line strongly to score first up at Kembla Grange apprentice ridden and as a gelding for the first time. He should have more to offer here with Adam Hyeronimus now aboard for the first time. SPARTUS performed well above market place expectations here when he tackled this trip two weeks ago and he can be expected to maintain his form today.

raceTips.comment: Action King has been racing with plenty of intent and looks suited by the chance to settle close to the speed, giving the gelding every opportunity to build momentum before the straight. Manukau possesses a useful turn of foot and should be able to secure a position with cover, which will allow him to be saved for one run late. Spartus has shown the ability to sustain a strong gallop and looks capable of being competitive if he finds a comfortable rhythm in the early stages. She's Extra has plenty of speed and can take up a prominent position, with the mare likely to give a strong kick when the pressure goes on.
